question: 'Straight from the Heart' is an autobiography of the famous cricketer ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapil Dev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kapil Dev** is a former Indian cricketer and the captain of the Indian cricket team.
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the greatest all-rounders to have played the game.
 
• Under his captaincy, India won its first **Cricket World Cup** in **1983**.
 
• His autobiography, "**Straight from the Heart**", gives insight into his journey and experiences as a cricketer.
 
• Kapil Dev is known for his **fast bowling** and aggressive **batting**.
 
• He held the record for the most wickets in Test cricket for a long time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sunil Gavaskar**__

 __
 
• **Sunil Gavaskar** is a former Indian cricketer known for his exceptional batting skills.
 
• He was the first player to score 10,000 runs in Test cricket.
 
• Gavaskar has written several books, including "Sunny Days" and "Idols".
 
 
 
• **Madan Lal**__
 __
 
• **Madan Lal** is a former Indian cricketer who played as an all-rounder.
 
• He was a part of the 1983 World Cup-winning team.
 
• Post-retirement, he has been involved in coaching and cricket commentary.
 
 
 
• **Mohinder Amarnath**__
 
 
• **Mohinder Amarnath** is a former Indian cricketer known for his pivotal role in the 1983 World Cup.
 
• He was awarded the **Man of the Match** in the 1983 World Cup final.
 
• Amarnath has also been a cricket coach and commentator.
